evals.prompt: I just set up a new Node.js app running on port 3000 locally. I want to expose it through Cloudflare Tunnel so I can access it at app.mydomain.com. Can you help me set up the tunnel from scratch? I haven't used cloudflared before.
evals.expected_output: A complete walkthrough covering login, tunnel creation, DNS routing, config.yml with ingress rule, and Windows service setup using the correct New-Service approach

evals.prompt: I already have a tunnel called 'main-tunnel' running with two services. I need to add a third service: Grafana running on http://localhost:3001, accessible at grafana.mydomain.com. Show me how to add this to the tunnel.
evals.expected_output: Use add-port.ps1 or manually: cloudflared tunnel route dns, add ingress rule to config.yml before 404 catch-all, restart service with taskkill+Start-Service

evals.prompt: My cloudflared tunnel was working fine yesterday but today it's not connecting. When I try to access my app I get a 502 error. Help me debug this step by step.
evals.expected_output: Diagnostic workflow: sc query/service status, cloudflared tunnel list for connections, validate config ingress, check local service, check tunnel.log, force restart with taskkill/Start-Service if needed

evals.prompt: I have a tunnel called 'my-tunnel' that I created last month, but I lost the credentials JSON file and now the tunnel won't connect. How do I recover it?
evals.expected_output: Use cloudflared tunnel token to get the token, decode from base64, write credentials JSON with [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText (not Set-Content to avoid BOM), then restart service
